_about: What verify/from-json.js cannot fill mechanically for purge-goes-the-foe, written by hand and read by it on every run (from-json.js --write gives the same data.js again). The list was first imported from New Recruit’s PDF (verify/import-nr.js); these are the values data.js had then that its JSON export and GW’s pages do not give, each as data.js showed it and as its review signed it off: source (the day the PDF was exported; the export has none), units.<id>: notes (GW’s words under a fixed source label, an FAQ or a Designer’s Note under an ability), short (the short name), kwOnly and partialRules (which model has a keyword or a core ability only some models of the unit have, where GW’s pages do not say it mechanically).

source.why: the day New Recruit’s PDF of this list was exported (verify/sources/nr/purge-goes-the-foe.txt), from which the list was first imported; the JSON export carries no date

notes.Supreme Commander: Wahapedia core rules, 25.04 Fill Your Army Roster: “Some units have a rule on their datasheet stating that they must be your WARLORD. If you want to include one or more of these units in your army, you must select one of them to be your WARLORD.”

belisarius-cawl.why: Supreme Commander: the Core Rules' 25.04 (Fill Your Army Roster) on what it means, quoted (verify/texts.js checks the quote).
